sloka: तथा वदति देवेशे द्विजास्ते सुसमाहिताः ।प्रसादयन्ति देवेशं यथा स्यात्पुरुषस्त्विला ।। ७.९०.१८ ॥
transliteration: tathā vadati deveśe dvijāste susamāhitāḥ ।prasādayanti deveśaṁ yathā syātpuruṣastvilā ।। 7.90.18 ॥

translations.english: When the lord of gods spoke thus, those attentive Brahmins propitiated him so that Ila might indeed become a man again.
